metadata.title: An exact formula for optimal axis-parallel packing of eight squares
metadata.abstract: We determine the smallest square container for eight axis-parallel squares of prescribed side lengths. The optimal side length is the minimum of the costs of 23 explicit packing strategies, and each cost is a maximum of sums of side lengths. No minimum of fewer convex functions represents it. Three strategies suffice for seven squares; the jump to 23 for eight squares witnesses the beginning of a combinatorial explosion. We prove the formula by combining the constructions with geometric lower bounds derived from disjoint coordinate projections, cornering arguments, and a weighted area comparison.
metadata.comment: 30 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Verification code: doi: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23504589

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 八方块轴平行装箱的精确公式
analysis.workSummary: 确定任意给定边长的八个轴平行正方形所需最小方形容器，其边长是23种显式策略成本的最小值，成本各为边长和的最大值，且不能用更少凸函数表达。
analysis.breakthrough: 将七块时三策略跃升为八块时23策略的复杂度精确化。
analysis.limitations: 禁止旋转且容器为正方形；23的最小性针对凸函数最小表示，不是所有可能算法的通用下界。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 Claude 辅助 CP-SAT 精确搜索和候选策略检验，几何策略提取多次需本人干预；GPT-6 Astra Pro 根据候选式发展并组装八条新下界及凸最小性论证，后经修订。Claude 与 GPT 辅助写稿审阅，Claude 生成精确验证代码；作者检查全部证明。本次未重跑证书。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.28504v1 · 第28–30页 Development of the results and AI assistance
